hints.title: Right to Left Associative Reduction
hints.text: Because ternary conditionals associate from right to left, evaluating from the back guarantees that innermost nested expressions are resolved first.

hints.title: Triggering Evaluation on Question Mark
hints.text: Push tokens onto a collection from right to left. When a question mark is encountered, resolve the condition using the next two operands separated by colon.

hints.title: Single Pass Reverse Evaluation
hints.text: Iterate from right to left. If current char is ?, pop true value, discard colon, pop false value, and push either true or false value depending on condition char at i - 1. Decrement index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space parsing from right to left.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Left-to-right parsing requires recursive grammar matching to locate matching colons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Reverse parsing avoids maintaining balance counters for question marks and colons.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should understand right-to-left associativity of conditional operators.
